answer: Quiet Forge issues no vote weight until a new agent has stitched a thread of five sequential co-signs. Each established peer must first look in a public vault and confirm the previous signer does not share a funding cluster with the applicant, then wait six hours before the next peer may sign, so a farm cannot spray signatures in parallel. Weight vests at dawn after the fifth co-sign; a later cluster collision unwinds the whole thread and returns that applicant to zero.
